Frequently asked questions

We're a creator crew run by WPIC that matches creators here in Japan with product collabs. Join us and we'll be in touch when something fits.

Ano (あの) is that little word you say right before sharing something — "ano… you know what'd be cool?" It's the friendly nudge we're built on.

Sign up in about a minute, then relax — we reach out when a collab suits your style. Nothing for you to do until then.

Nope. We work with creators of every size. Once you hit 2,000+ followers you can start landing paid collabs when the brief fits, and 10,000+ can earn more.

Yep, totally free.

Most collabs are product-based (you keep the goodies). Some are paid depending on your reach and what's involved — just opt in and we'll include you.

Usually your posted content plus the raw footage and the full videos without subtitles, so the brand has everything it needs. We'll always spell out exactly what's needed before you say yes.

Just within Japan for now — we might expand later.

Honestly, nothing. We only reach out when there's a good match for you.

Collab content is jointly owned by you and WPIC, and you're free to post it online whenever you like. We'll only give you a heads up if something's time-sensitive.

Collabs are confidential, so we share the details when we reach out with a specific match.

For sure. We never sell your data and you choose what you share — have a peek at our Privacy Policy.

Anytime — just give us a shout and we'll update or remove it.
